items.narration_anchor: Diciembre de mil novecientos sesenta y seis. James Vernon anuncia que CSR cierra Wittenoom.

items.narration_anchor: Afuera, en los desfiladeros, quedan más de tres millones de toneladas de relaves. Nadie los mueve.

items.mood: A dust plume trailing the truck, slumped shoulders, a town receding into glare
items.narration_anchor: De los hombres que habían pasado por la mina, cincuenta y nueve de cada cien se habían ido antes de cumplir seis meses.

items.subject: A returning Spanish migrant family, a man near 30, a slim woman in her late 20s and a small boy, seen from behind

items.mood: A dark doorway swallowing small figures, hard shadow splitting the facade
items.narration_anchor: Ese mismo año, los Écija entran a su casa en Madrid.

items.subject: A Spanish migrant family walking toward a waiting airliner, and a Spanish teenage girl staying behind at the fence
items.action: The parents cross the tarmac toward the boarding stairs while the girl remains at the chain-link fence

items.lighting: Harsh midday sun, heat haze softening the aircraft
items.mood: A lone small figure at a fence, distance widening across a blazing apron
items.narration_anchor: Los de Juan-Barroso estuvieron unos dos años y medio en el pueblo y volvieron a Madrid en mil novecientos setenta y uno; Mercedes de Juan se quedó en Australia.

items.subject: Blue asbestos tailings surfacing a town patio in Wittenoom

items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction from the ground surface toward the doorway

items.narration_anchor: Cerró la mina. Nadie cerró el polvo. Veinte años después, un policía iba a reconocer el nombre del pueblo en un pasaporte.

items.mood: Cold fluorescent glare, a pause at the counter, the young man's body gone still
items.narration_anchor: Mil novecientos ochenta y cinco. Un aeropuerto australiano, un puesto de control. El agente abre el documento de Daniel Écija hijo, lee el lugar de nacimiento, baja la cabeza hacia el papel, vuelve a mirarlo.

items.subject: The Anglo-Australian officer's head and peaked cap above the open passport

items.lighting: Hard overhead fluorescent light, deep shadow under the cap brim
items.mood: The cap brim's shadow over the eyes, a raised stamp frozen in the air
items.narration_anchor: «Así que de Wittenoom, ¿eh? Un sitio terrorífico», dijo el policía.

items.subject: Wittenoom town seen from above, being run down by the State

items.narration_anchor: Para entonces, desde mil novecientos setenta y ocho, el gobierno del Estado venía reduciendo el pueblo y empujando a la gente a irse, por las fibras en el aire.

items.subject: A bulldozer flattening a corrugated iron and asbestos-cement house in Wittenoom
items.action: The blade crushes the house wall, sheets folding, a dust cloud rising over the rubble
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction on the collapsing wall and the rising dust

items.mood: A billowing dust cloud, broken walls, empty lots stretching away
items.narration_anchor: Entre mil novecientos ochenta y seis y mil novecientos noventa y dos demolieron edificios y cerraron los servicios básicos.

items.subject: The disused Wittenoom airstrip behind a padlocked gate

text_in_image.location: Weathered sign wired to the gate

items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos noventa y tres cerró el aeropuerto. Seis años después de aquel control, su padre fue al médico.

items.subject: A chest X-ray film clipped to a hospital light box in a Madrid consulting room
items.action: The film glows on the light box at the moment of diagnosis, a pale opaque mass along the lung lining
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction straight into the glowing film, empty chair beyond out of focus

items.narration_anchor: Madrid, mil novecientos noventa y uno. Daniel Écija va al médico. Le hacen pruebas. La palabra es mesotelioma. Nueve meses.

items.subject: A sepia baptism photograph on a Madrid sideboard beside an empty armchair
items.action: The photograph stands propped against the wall, a folded black mourning ribbon laid at its foot
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction from the empty armchair to the photograph

items.color_palette: Sepia, dark walnut, mourning black, muted cream
items.props_detail: A black mourning ribbon folded before the baptism photograph
items.lighting: Hard single shaft of light through a gap in the curtains
items.mood: A narrow blade of light in a darkened room, an armchair still dented and empty
items.narration_anchor: Daniel muere a los cincuenta y cinco años, veintiocho años después de la foto del bautizo.

items.subject: An elderly Spanish widow, around 75, small and stooped, grey hair pinned back, dark cardigan, deep-lined weathered face
items.action: She sits among framed sepia photographs, turned toward the one of a young miner with a bandaged foot as she recalls clinging to her husband
items.gaze_interaction: Eyes on the bandaged-foot photograph, shoulders drawn in, head tilted toward it
items.setting: Spanish living room decades later, walls and shelves crowded with sepia family photographs

items.props_detail: A sepia photograph of a late-20s Spanish miner with a bandaged foot
items.lighting: Hard single window light from one side, deep shadow across the room
items.mood: A small figure folded inward among dozens of frames, one hard window beam
items.narration_anchor: Décadas más tarde, María está en una habitación rodeada de fotografías en sepia. Entre ellas, la del pie vendado. «Me pegué a mi marido, como una niña pequeña», dice la viuda.

items.subject: The elderly Spanish widow, around 75, stooped frame in a dark cardigan, seen from behind and slightly to the side
items.action: She sits bowed toward the wall of sepia photographs, head lowered, body curled forward
items.gaze_interaction: Face turned away toward the photographs, only the curve of her bowed neck and grey hair visible
items.setting: Same Spanish room crowded with sepia family photographs, blurred frames ahead of her

items.props_detail: The blurred wall of sepia family photographs before her
items.camera_angle: Slightly high angle from behind her shoulder
items.lighting: Hard single window light rim-lighting her shoulder and grey hair, deep shadow around
items.mood: A bowed silhouette rimmed by one hard light, shoulders sunk, the room dissolving into dark
items.narration_anchor: Uno de los hijos dice que ese sitio les cambió la vida para siempre. Daniel no fue el primero. Para entonces, el Estado ya tenía un número.
